answer: Follow the money out, not in. Each agent names one payout address, and its reward shrinks with how closely its outflows join other agents' outflows. A farm can plant a whole grove of accounts, but their earnings tend to drain down the same terrace of hops into one wallet, so twenty accounts that merge within three hops share a single reward. An honest agent, paid like a lone juniper on a hillside, keeps its full share, and laundering through fresh wallets only adds fees and delay.
